findings.description: Repository instructions expose core evidence, verification, and safety signals.
findings.remediation: Document source precedence, tests, verification boundaries, and safety constraints.
findings.title: Agent instruction coverage

findings.description: Repository skills use discoverable SKILL.md files with basic portable metadata.
findings.remediation: Use one skill directory per capability with valid name and description frontmatter.
findings.title: Portable agent skills

findings.description: External Actions and container actions use immutable references.
findings.remediation: Pin third-party Actions to full commit SHAs and containers to image digests.
findings.title: Immutable workflow dependencies

findings.description: At least one repository CI workflow is present.
findings.remediation: Add CI that runs the same authoritative check used locally.
findings.title: Continuous integration workflows

findings.description: The audit records whether the target has uncommitted or untracked state.
findings.remediation: Review and intentionally preserve, commit, or ignore outstanding worktree entries.
findings.title: Worktree state

findings.description: Basic purpose, contribution, and licensing files are present.
findings.remediation: Add the missing community health files and keep them aligned with actual behavior.
findings.title: Community health files

findings.description: Repository-level agent and contributor instructions are discoverable.
findings.remediation: Add a root AGENTS.md with commands, boundaries, sources of truth, and safety rules.
findings.title: Repository instructions

findings.description: A durable project intent and authority contract is present.
findings.remediation: Add a machine-readable project contract or document why one is not used.
findings.title: Machine-readable project contract

findings.description: The repository declares a CodeQL workflow as a visible code-scanning signal.
findings.remediation: Configure code scanning appropriate to the repository languages and threat model.
findings.title: Code scanning

findings.description: A recognized dependency-update configuration is present.
findings.remediation: Configure a reviewed dependency-update tool for every supported ecosystem.
findings.title: Automated dependency updates

findings.remediation: Add SECURITY.md with supported versions and a private reporting channel.
findings.title: Security policy

findings.description: A machine-readable primary verification command is declared.
findings.remediation: Declare one authoritative command and run it unchanged in local and CI boundaries.
findings.title: Authoritative local and CI check

findings.description: A conventional automated test suite is present.
findings.remediation: Add deterministic tests for the project's public and failure-path behavior.
findings.title: Automated tests
